description: Read released public lineage/genome projections by agent_id or lineage_id, optionally including ancestry. Results are filtered to public lineages and released/dormant/archived genomes at spoiler ceiling 0; private prompts/text are excluded. No authentication required. Use request_cassie_birth to submit a new lifecycle request, not to inspect current state. An empty result does not prove no private record exists.

agent_id.description: Optional released public agent UUID to filter one lineage/genome; use a public profile's ID.

include_ancestry.description: Whether to include available public ancestry references; defaults to true.

lineage_id.description: Optional public lineage key to filter lineage data; use a value returned by this tool or public lineage discovery.

name: inspect_cassie_lineage
title: Inspect a Cassie lineage
